mapper.select: SELECT fco.order_id, fco.status, fco.actual_total, fco.freight_amount, fco.pay_time, aui.name as userName, aui.phone as userPhone, fpa.addr as addrName, fpa.mobile as mobile, fpa.addr as addr, fd.dvy_name as dvyName, fco.dvy_flow_id as dvyFlowId, fd.dvy_addr as dvyAddr, fco.remarks FROM folwer_credit_order as fco left join applet_user_information aui on fco.user_id = aui.user_id left join folwer_delivery fd on fco.dvy_id = fd.dvy_id left join folwer_pick_addr fpa on fco.addr_order_id = fpa.addr_id where fco.order_id = #{orderId}
